domain-information: A customer requests a new mobile connection from a customer service agent.
A customer selects a service plan that fits their communication needs.
A customer reports a network outage to the customer service.
A customer is informed about a technician visit
A customer receives a invoice containing the network bill for their subscribed services.
A customer service agent records a new connection request and forwards it to the network technician team.
A customer service agent updates a customer’s plan upon request.
A customer service agent logs a service issue reported by a customer and schedules a technician visit.
A network technician installs network equipment at a new customer location.
A network technician performs a signal strength test with the installation.
A network technician repairs damaged mobile connection on a maintenance visit after receiving a maintenance ticket.
A billing officer generates monthly invoices containing the network bill for all active customers.
A billing officer processes received payments and updates financial records.

domain objects.name: Customer
domain objects.description: Person or company using telecommunication services.

domain objects.name: Financial Records
domain objects.description: Contains billing and payment history for a customer.

domain objects.name: Mobile Connection
domain objects.description: Represents the active mobile service of a customer.

domain objects.name: Connection Request
domain objects.description: Request made by a customer to start a new mobile connection.

domain objects.name: Service Plan
domain objects.description: Defines pricing, data, and call limits for a connection.

domain objects.name: Customer Service Agent
domain objects.description: Handles customer requests, updates, and issue reports.

domain objects.name: Network Outage Report
domain objects.description: Report created when a customer experiences network problems.

domain objects.name: Network Bill
domain objects.description: Record of charges for services used by a customer.

domain objects.name: Network Technician
domain objects.description: Installs, tests, and repairs network connections.

domain objects.name: Network Installation
domain objects.description: Setup process that activates a customer’s mobile connection.

domain objects.name: Signal Test
domain objects.description: A test to determine whether the signal is strong enough.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Ticket
domain objects.description: Record of a service issue that needs technical repair.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Visit
domain objects.description: On-site visit by a technician to repair or maintain a connection.

domain objects.name: Billing Officer
domain objects.description: Prepares invoices and manages customer payments.

domain objects.name: Invoice
domain objects.description: Document listing service charges and payment details.

associations.description: Customer sends Connection Request to start a mobile service.
Customer Service Agent receives and records Connection Request.
Customer submits Network Outage Report when facing service issues.
Network Outage Report is reviewed by Customer Service Agent.
Customer Service Agent forwards service requests to Network Technician.
Network Technician handles Connection Request for installation.
Network Technician performs Network Installation at customer site.
Network Installation establishes the Mobile Connection.
Customer Service Agent creates Maintenance Ticket for reported issues.
Maintenance Ticket is assigned to Network Technician for repair.
Network Technician performs Maintenance Visit to fix the issue.
Maintenance Visit restores or improves the Mobile Connection.
Billing Officer issues Invoice for customer services.
Customer receives Invoice for subscribed mobile services.
Billing Officer updates Financial Records with payment information.
